Record Class Education

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.jsonschema.generator.ref.Education
Record Components:
Title - Descriptive title of the education. Cannot be blank
Type - Education kind, i.e.: professional education or college. Cannot be blank
From - Start date of the classes. It must be equals or before the end date
To - End date of the classes. Should be set to a date equals or before today
Area - Studies subject, i.e.: Computer Science. If set, it cannot be blank
Summary - Brief description of the studies. If set, blank values aren't allowed
public record Education(@NotNull String Title, @NotNull String Type, @NotNull Organization Institution, @Pattern(regexp="\\d{4}-\\d{2}") @NotNull String From, String Website, @Pattern(regexp="\\d{4}-\\d{2}") String To, String Area, NullableLocation Location, String Summary, String Score, Set<String> Subjects) extends Record

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
      Specified by:
